sn1.8:1.2: Standing to one side, a devatā addressed the Blessed One with a verse:
sn1.8:2.1:
“Those for whom
phenomena are thoroughly confused,
sn1.8:2.2:
who may be led
by the teachings of others:
sn1.8:2.3:
Asleep are they;
they haven’t awakened.
sn1.8:2.4:
It’s time for them
to awaken.”
sn1.8:3.1: The Buddha: “Those for whom phenomena are not confused,
sn1.8:3.2:
may not be led
by the teachings of others.
sn1.8:3.4:
they go among the discordant
harmoniously.”
